state.name: Edit Tag — Open
state.purpose: Rename a tag and choose its color in the same sheet used to create a tag.

color.label: Tag color
color.helper: Choose a color to identify this tag.

form.preview: sell icon in the selected color and the current name
form.colorUse: The color is applied to the sell icon and the preview. It does not paint the tag row, and it does not replace the teal selection border on Home.

behavior.save: update name and color together, keep id, pin state, and task links
